about_the_game:
Try the Lovecraftian Repair Experience – for Free

This Sunken Engine Demo offers a glimpse into the eerie world of ship repair in a Lovecraftian setting. Step into the shoes of a new business owner after your father's mysterious passing, and experience the atmosphere, mechanics, and unsettling tone of the full game.

What's in the Demo?

In this demo, you'll begin your journey on the haunted island, repair your first ship, and explore the early mechanics of the game. While it's only a slice of the full experience, there’s plenty of mystery and tension to sink into.

Start the Repairs

Test your skills with basic ship repair tasks using our tool-based interaction system. Discover how each task has its own rhythm—and how some ships seem... off. Even at this early stage, darkness lurks beneath the surface.

Explore and Scavenge

During the demo, you'll also get access to the shop behind your repair station where you can manage and sell items recovered from wrecks. Every piece tells a story, and some stories refuse to stay buried.

Stay Tuned for More

The full version of Sunken Engine will take you deeper into the madness, with larger ships, more tools, a progressing story, and increasingly surreal horrors. Wishlist the game to be notified at launch!

content_descriptors.notes: Players may encounter disturbing crime scenes that feature blood and signs of violence, as they take on the role of a cleaner tasked with restoring these places. The story occasionally touches on sensitive subjects such as suicide, trauma, and mental instability, presented through documents, environmental storytelling, and dialogue. While there is no explicit sexual content or nudity, some narrative elements suggest past abuse or psychological manipulation. These themes are presented with care and are integral to the slow-building cosmic horror experience the game offers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (or equivalent AMD)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: Sunken Engine Demo offers an atmospheric preview of the Lovecraftian Ship Repair Simulator. Repair your first ship, explore your surroundings, and survive the creeping dread of the sea.
